text:
Haan ji, aapki complaint successfully register ho gayi hai. 

Investigation ka update aapko agle 24 se 48 ghanto mein SMS aur email ke zariye mil jayega. Abhi ke liye hamara system refund aur internal logistics ticket ID ko order ID (ORD-22004) ke saath hi track karta hai, isliye koi alag se reference number generate nahi hua hai. Aapki order ID hi aapka reference hai.

Kya main aapki kisi aur cheez mein madad kar sakta hoon?
